saw_lines: Brands rarely buy a creator platform from a demo. They judge it on one campaign and how fast briefs go live.
So the sale is won on the homepage, where a founder decides in seconds whether a platform fits their brand.
Your site promises creators in hours, so put that exact promise in a paid ad with a first campaign offer, and test it against the AI brief angle.
